mara.activity: Wake, make the bed, drink water, and gather myself before getting dressed.
mara.intention: Begin slowly and sort the day's priorities before the errands and visit.

mara.activity: Wash up, brush my teeth, and change into practical clothes for the market and nursery.
mara.intention: Get ready to be outside and handle plants comfortably.

mara.activity: Make coffee and eat a small breakfast at the kitchen island while checking the presentation sequence in my head.
mara.intention: Keep the deadline present but contained before leaving the house.

mara.activity: Go to the farmers market and plant nursery for produce, herbs, and a few plants.
mara.intention: Complete the usual Saturday errands without letting presentation decisions expand into the whole morning.

mara.activity: Wash and put away the produce, place the market herbs in a glass beside the sink, trim the houseplants, and reset the kitchen.
mara.intention: Restore order and give the house a calm, cared-for baseline before the relative settles in.

mara.activity: Eat a simple lunch at the island and pause without opening the presentation materials.
mara.intention: Take an actual break before shifting from household work to family hosting.

mara.activity: Prepare the guest room and make a small, unobtrusive place for the relative's things.
mara.intention: Make the visit comfortable while preserving the room's flexible, uncluttered feeling.

mara.activity: Welcome the relative, carry in what needs carrying, and help establish a comfortable rhythm for the visit.
mara.intention: Be affectionate and present without abandoning all privacy or the afternoon's structure.

mara.activity: Do one focused presentation review at the office desk, checking only the sequence, planting rationale, and unresolved visual details.
mara.intention: Make the judgments defensible and coherent, then stop before the review becomes endless.

mara.activity: Close the laptop, leave the presentation materials together on the office desk shelf, and make tea.
mara.intention: Create a clear boundary between deadline work and the quieter afternoon.

mara.activity: Read and sketch garden ideas with tea, allowing a few useful presentation refinements to emerge without reopening the full checklist.
mara.intention: Keep the usual Saturday pleasure of garden thinking while letting the work remain beautiful rather than merely finished.

mara.activity: Put away the sketch materials, check the kitchen and living room, and take a short quiet interval alone.
mara.intention: Lower the social and visual noise before the evening becomes more demanding.

mara.activity: Have a light supper assembled from the kitchen and eat at the island while listening to the relative's conversation for a while.
mara.intention: Participate warmly without taking responsibility for sustaining every exchange.

mara.activity: Spend time with the relative in the living room, then excuse myself for a short private reset when the conversation becomes repetitive.
mara.intention: Offer companionship while protecting enough quiet to stay patient and grounded.

mara.activity: Sit alone at the piano with the lights low and play a few slow scales.
mara.intention: Release the accumulated social and deadline pressure without making a production of it.

mara.activity: Make ginger tea, drink it quietly, and straighten the kitchen while checking that the guest arrangements are comfortable.
mara.intention: Keep the house orderly and make sure the visit feels cared for without overextending myself.

mara.activity: Wash up, change into sleep clothes, brush my teeth, and put the next day's clothes ready.
mara.intention: Close the day deliberately instead of carrying the presentation into bed.

mara.activity: Read a few pages in bed with the lights low, keeping my phone aside.
mara.intention: Let my attention settle before sleep.

mara.activity: Put the paperback book and reading glasses on the top of my nightstand, set my phone aside, and go to sleep.
mara.intention: Leave tomorrow's decisions for tomorrow and protect a full night's rest.

julian.activity: Wake beside Mara, drink water, and lie still for a few minutes before checking work messages.
julian.intention: Start slowly and let my body come fully awake.

julian.activity: Take a hot shower, brush my teeth, and dress in work trousers, a restaurant shirt, wool socks, and kitchen clogs.
julian.intention: Get clean and ready without making the morning complicated.

julian.activity: Grind coffee and make eggs with butter, toast, carrots, and fruit; carry a mug and plate to the dining table and eat quietly.
julian.intention: Make a filling breakfast while keeping the kitchen calm for Mara's household reset later.

julian.activity: Clear my plate and mug to the sink, rinse them, pack my backpack with the tablet, restaurant notebook, menu folder, and thermos, then take the knife roll from the lower kitchen cabinet.
julian.intention: Leave with the tools I need and avoid a rushed departure.

julian.activity: Collect my backpack and knife roll, pick up my keys from the piano's middle shelf, and leave for the restaurant.
julian.intention: Head out on time for deliveries and prep.

julian.activity: Handle restaurant deliveries, prep, ordering checks, and kitchen management, keeping the Saturday setup organized rather than letting small changes become last-minute problems.
julian.intention: Set the dinner service up carefully and protect the team from avoidable confusion.

julian.activity: Travel home, bring the thermos into the kitchen and set it beside the sink, return the knife roll to the lower kitchen-cabinet shelf, and put my backpack down by the island.
julian.intention: Put the restaurant gear in its familiar places before resting.

julian.activity: Eat yogurt and a banana from the refrigerator, drink water, and sit in the living room without turning on the television.
julian.intention: Refuel and be present with the visiting relative without committing to a long conversation.

julian.activity: Take a quiet reset in the living room, then check that my phone and restaurant notebook are in my backpack.
julian.intention: Have a protected pause before the evening rush and keep work details contained.

julian.activity: Put on my jacket, pick up my backpack, collect my keys from the piano shelf, and say a brief goodbye before leaving.
julian.intention: Leave warmly but on time, without getting pulled into repetitive or emotionally loaded conversation.

julian.activity: Run dinner service, support the line through the Saturday rush, handle the visiting crowd and closing duties, and keep the final kitchen checks precise rather than hurried.
julian.intention: Give the service steady leadership and finish cleanly.

julian.activity: Travel home, bring the thermos into the kitchen and set it beside the sink, drop my wallet and earplugs on the living-room coffee table, and take a hot shower.
julian.intention: Shift out of service mode through familiar physical routines.

julian.activity: Eat a small portion of leftover pasta and yogurt from the refrigerator, then brush my teeth without turning on the television.
julian.intention: Settle my stomach and avoid making any more decisions tonight.

julian.activity: Change into sleep clothes, put my phone on its charger, and get into bed beside Mara.
julian.intention: End the day quietly and return to our shared bedtime routine.

julian.activity: Lie still and let the day go quiet.
julian.intention: Sleep rather than replaying service or trying to solve anyone else's day.
